Closest-to-a-count-issue: chunk 30 (L433-437) carries a second bolded sentence mid-paragraph in two of its three entries ('**First stop when Claude seems to be ignoring a rule:**' after the `/memory` lead; '**Use when the conversation feels heavy:**' after the `/context` lead) — a secondary emphasis beyond the one-lead-per-entry pattern, but each is itself a short handle-shaped clause (not a run-on, not crossing its own sentence boundary) functioning as a practical-use pointer rather than narrative decoration; filed as a suggestion, not a REVISE, since the harm (a slide fighting for attention) is marginal on a two-command-per-slide lookup entry and the fix is a taste call, not a clear violation.
